The minimal candidate runs C, F and dwell on 64 fresh initial-world seeds per retained base, in one serial six-panel process. C always applies the learned sampled proposal b. F uses the accepted own-link-loss and away-pointing-proposal predicate and inverses the UAV's prior actual realized displacement under the existing velocity scale/clipping. Dwell evaluates the same predicate on its own history and sampled b and sends zero xyz velocity when eligible. Neither arm borrows another arm's event times, future observations, mask or action history. The unchanged learned proposer samples every primitive step even when overridden, retains private recurrent state, resets state at episode boundaries and receives its actual sent-command feedback. Fixed execution rules do not make this an untrained or deterministic controller. The finite five-UAV roster, 50 users, 256-step host and native team reward remain.

Keep the MARL path explicit: joint motion/interference changes one UAV's private own-link observation; a retained coordinate-bound anchor and sampled away proposal permit apply/retrace/dwell; resulting joint geometry, assignment and teammate observations affect native return. Own-link loss may be beneficial handoff. F-dwell compares complete closed-loop execution packages on their own trajectories; it does not identify the necessity of history, counterfactually matched cue effects or partner co-adaptation. The strongest simpler alternative is that rejecting motion already supplies the benefit. The proposed direct finite measurement discriminates retrace reuse from that alternative better than more selector fits, a support census, exact upper, broad causal diagnosis or controller search would answer this particular fixed-asset question.

The card reports primary mean paired F-C and F-dwell in J separately for each base, retaining secondary dwell-C and all 384 episode S/J returns. S is the 256-step sum and J=S/256. Its proposed MEI is 0.01 J=2.56 S; UP if the signed mean difference exceeds 0.01, DOWN below -0.01, otherwise WITHIN with its sign. This is a bounded investment reading, not significance or equivalence. Each conditional SE uses 64 paired joint-episode differences; the two bases have distinct fresh panels. No best-base selection, aggregate primary or training-population interval is proposed. A local gain may justify bounded follow-up while other native losses remain visible; all signs need not be positive. The exact private proposal/reset/constructor seed law is on card section 3, with computed ranges but no RNG constructed.

Both base fits are old, and DENSE/8201 was originally chosen after both old outcomes were visible. Adding 8202 now leaves a selection-conditional two-base set, not two new independent training pairs. Accepted historical F-C gains +0.0962618653/+0.1078445744 J both concern DENSE/8201 under separate old panels; there is no dwell result and no F result on DENSE/8202 in those observations. P80's repeated T/G-F losses and changing T-G sign remain. There is no current tuned same-information host headroom record; F is an attained comparator, not an upper. Original 0.25 S=0.0009765625 J, R02's positive legal-history witness, R03's compatible-history upper/old-host end and all contrary native evidence are preserved. The new MEI does not rescue old claims.
